name: Leela, Sevateem Warrior
oracle_text:
Whenever an opponent draws a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, put a +1/+1 counter on Leela.
Doctor's companion (You can have two commanders if the other is the Doctor.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever an opponent draws a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, put a +1/+1 counter on Leela.

needs.what: a `draw` trigger key (e.g. `except_first_in_draw_step: true`) that skips the drawing player's first card drawn during their own draw step, read off the existing `state.cards_drawn_this_draw_step` ledger, so the trigger fires on every other draw by an opponent
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `except_first_in_draw_step` exists only on the `replace_draw` player static, not in `trigger_keys`; the `draw` trigger's `nth`/`max_per_turn` count per turn, not per draw step; a `condition` built from `step_is` plus `cards_drawn_this_turn` miscounts draws made earlier in the turn (upkeep) and cannot ask whether the drawer is the active player in their own draw step
